name: my-cross-run
_doc: Pipeline: run_cross.sh  —  generator model (fixed) produces completions via vLLM; trainee model scores, computes logps, and trains on those completions using its own chat template.

models._generator: Path to the fixed generator model. This model NEVER gets updated; it only serves completions via vLLM.
models._trainee: Path to the initial trainee model. This model is updated at each step.

dataset._key: Dataset identifier. Options: 'math_lighteval', 'gsm8k', etc. See utils/dataset.py.
dataset._max_samples: Cap on total problems loaded. null = use all.
dataset._system_prompt: System message prepended to every prompt.
dataset.system_prompt: You are a helpful AI Assistant, designed to provided well-reasoned and detailed responses. You FIRST think about the reasoning process step by step and then provide the user with the answer. Please enclose your final answer in the box: \boxed{Your Answer}. Please stop generation immediately after outputing the box.
dataset._prompt_mode: Predefined prompt preset: 'system' (system prompt, no suffix), 'suffix' (no system, instruction suffix), 'bare' (nothing, TTRL style). null = use individual fields.
dataset._instruction_suffix: Instruction suffix appended to user message. null = use per-dataset default. Empty string = no suffix.
dataset._enable_thinking: Control enable_thinking for chat template. 'false' (default), 'true', 'none' (don't pass — TTRL style).

generation._num_generations: Completions generated per problem by the generator model.
generation._max_completion_length: Max tokens per completion (vLLM max_tokens and training cap).

scoring._scoring_batch_size: Prompts per scoring batch (trainee in-process). Reduce if GPU OOM.
scoring._logps_batch_size: Prompts per logp batch (trainee in-process). Reduce if GPU OOM.
scoring._mask_truncated_completions: Deprecated. Has no effect; kept for compatibility.

reward._mode: Reward method. Options: 'intuitor' (self-certainty score), 'truth' (ground-truth 0/1 from dataset answer_column), 'wmv' (weighted majority vote), 'mv' (unweighted majority vote).
reward._scorer: HACRL scorer backend for mode='truth'. Options: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em.
reward._beta: KL penalty coefficient β. 0.0 = no KL penalty.

training._start_step: Step to resume from. 0 = start fresh.
training._per_device_batch_size: Per-GPU micro-batch size. Effective batch = num_gpus × per_device_batch_size × gradient_accumulation_steps.
training._gradient_accumulation_steps: Accumulation steps. Set so effective_batch = problems_per_step × num_generations. Example: 128p × 7gen / (2gpu × 2bs) = 224.
training._warmup_ratio: Fraction of steps for linear LR warmup.
training._torch_dtype: Model dtype. 'bfloat16' recommended for Ampere+ GPUs.
training._gradient_checkpointing: Recompute activations to save memory (~30% slower).
training._num_iterations: GRPO update iterations per step. 1 = standard.

vllm._port: vLLM server port for the generator model.
vllm._gpu: CUDA device index for the vLLM server. Should be separate from training GPUs.
vllm._max_model_len: Max sequence length (prompt + completion) for vLLM. Must be ≤ model's max_position_embeddings.
vllm._max_num_batched_tokens: Max total tokens per vLLM batch.
vllm._chunked_prefill: Enable chunked prefill for mixed-length sequences.
vllm._start_timeout: Seconds to wait for vLLM health check before abort.

output._ttrl_dir: Root directory for TTRL evaluation results.

eval._doc: Each evaluation backend is independently toggleable. Set 'enabled' to true and fill in 'tasks' to activate.
eval._max_new_tokens: Max tokens generated during evaluation (shared across backends).
eval._local_datasets_root: Local HuggingFace dataset cache directory (shared across backends).

lighteval._doc: LightEval backend (vLLM). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
lighteval._prompt_mode: Prompt preset for lighteval wrapper: 'system' (use system_prompt) | 'bare' (no system).
lighteval._system_prompt: Optional lighteval-only system prompt. null = fall back to dataset.system_prompt.

zeroeval._doc: ZeroEval backend (CRUXEval etc.). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.

hacrl._doc: HACRL scorer backend (sympy / Minerva / boxed / QA). Set enabled=true, pick a scorer, and list tasks.
hacrl._scorers: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em

ttrl._doc: TTRL evaluation backend (TTRL-style scoring on TTT datasets). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
